patent.ref: Marc Grégoire patents bonding Teflon to aluminium, France
patent.ref_zh: 格雷瓜尔在法国获得把特氟龙黏合到铝上的专利

mass_production.ref: Flat-bottomed cast-iron skillets arrive with cooking stoves, late 19th century
mass_production.ref_zh: 19 世纪末随炉灶普及出现平底铸铁煎锅

popularization.ref: Grégoire founds Tefal to sell non-stick cookware
popularization.ref_zh: 格雷瓜尔创立特福（Tefal）销售不粘锅

notes: 来源较弱：古代美索不达米亚铜锅没有具体年代，因此不设发明年；本条目以 19 世纪末平底铸铁煎锅为主年份。
summary_zh: 古代美索不达米亚已有铜制煎锅；19 世纪末炉灶普及带来平底铸铁煎锅；1954 年法国的格雷瓜尔发明不粘锅涂层工艺。
summary_en: Copper frying pans were used in ancient Mesopotamia; flat cast-iron skillets came with cooking stoves in the late 19th century; in 1954 France's Marc Grégoire patented a non-stick coating.

image.alt_en: A non-stick frying pan with a black handle

notes_en: Weak sourcing: the ancient Mesopotamian copper pans have no specific date, so invention is left null and the late-19th-century flat cast-iron skillet is the primary year.
